dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service provides a point inventory of water appurtenances maintained by Westbank First Nation (WFN). It supports operational tracking and asset management for water system components across the service area.

Feature Content

  • Water points representing appurtenances such as air release valves, blow offs, caps, curb stops, manholes, reducers, and valves.
  • Supporting asset details for each point, including jurisdiction, condition, operation and maintenance rating, installation date, orientation, and asset identification.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers Westbank First Nation (WFN) managed water infrastructure within the Regional District of Central Okanagan area and related jurisdictions served by the network.

Use Cases

  • Water utility asset inventory and maintenance planning
  • Operational mapping of valves and other appurtenances
  • Condition assessment and lifecycle tracking
  • Supporting field crews, inspections, and infrastructure updates

Source and Use

Created and maintained by Westbank First Nation (WFN) and hosted on RDCO servers, this service is available under the Regional District of Central Okanagan open data license and terms of use.
